moratoriums.name: Oldham County
moratoriums.notes: Disputed: the judge-executive said in August 2026 it had "effectively expired"; magistrates disputed that, and no regulations have been adopted.

moratoriums.name: Simpson County
moratoriums.notes: Litigated

moratoriums.name: Calvert County
moratoriums.notes: Six-month moratorium on data center site plans (Ordinance 42-26), passed August 18, 2026.

moratoriums.name: Montgomery County
moratoriums.notes: County Council Expedited Bill 19-26, 18 months; replaces the executive six-month order of June 12

moratoriums.name: Prince George's County
moratoriums.notes: Extended

moratoriums.name: Missoula County
moratoriums.notes: Technically crypto

moratoriums.name: St. Lawrence County
moratoriums.notes: A county resolution affirming local authority over data center siting and urging towns to consider moratoriums; not a moratorium or zoning rule.

moratoriums.name: Buncombe County
moratoriums.notes: Replaced by permanent data center rules.

moratoriums.name: Surry County
moratoriums.notes: Extended

moratoriums.name: Stutsman County
moratoriums.notes: Data centers must be at least 2 miles from any building or structure and 3 miles from any existing data center.

moratoriums.name: Montour County
moratoriums.notes: Replaced by permanent data center rules.

moratoriums.name: Colleton County
moratoriums.notes: Council's 6-month pause on data center development; partly repealed Sept 15, 2026 for land west of I-95 and for parcels already zoned industrial under the new Digital Infrastructure Overlay District.

moratoriums.name: Greenwood County
moratoriums.notes: First reading approved

moratoriums.name: Laurens County
moratoriums.notes: First reading approved

moratoriums.name: Spartanburg County
moratoriums.notes: Applies only to data centers over 65 MW; does not affect projects already approved, including Valara.

moratoriums.name: Hawkins County
moratoriums.notes: Litigated

moratoriums.name: Box Elder County
moratoriums.notes: Does not apply to Stratos

moratoriums.name: Loudoun County
moratoriums.notes: Board of Supervisors voted 7-1-1 on Sept 15, 2026 to pause new data center applications for 12 months, effective immediately; a formal resolution goes to the board Oct 20, 2026.

moratoriums.name: Prince William County (countywide end of by-right zoning)
moratoriums.notes: Board of County Supervisors voted 8-0 to end by-right data center development countywide, replacing it with a special use permit process requiring a public hearing and board vote; a 90-day grace period applies to pending plans.

moratoriums.name: Skagit County
moratoriums.notes: Considering ban

moratoriums.name: New York
moratoriums.notes: Executive Order 62: up to one year, for data centers of 50 MW or more; ends earlier if the state finishes its environmental impact statement.

moratoriums.name: Texas
moratoriums.notes: Grid connection moratorium

moratoriums.name: Israel (national)
moratoriums.notes: 140-day freeze on new grid connections for data centers of 8 MW or more

moratoriums.name: Lleida
moratoriums.notes: First Spanish city to ban data centers

moratoriums.name: Oakville
moratoriums.notes: One-year interim control bylaw, the first in Ontario

moratoriums.name: Rocky View County
moratoriums.notes: Pause on data center rezonings until new county rules are approved

moratoriums.name: Mississauga
moratoriums.notes: Council directed staff to draft a one-year interim control bylaw

moratoriums.name: Sault Ste. Marie
moratoriums.notes: Draft moratorium on data centers over 50 MW, vote expected Sept 21, 2026

moratoriums.name: Lakeland
moratoriums.notes: Covers data centers and other users of 50 MW or more.

moratoriums.name: Walton County
moratoriums.notes: Permanent ban in place by July 15, 2026; adoption date to confirm.

moratoriums.name: Zephyrhills
moratoriums.notes: Six-month moratorium in place by July 15, 2026; start date to confirm.

moratoriums.name: Orange County
moratoriums.notes: Commissioners backed a temporary moratorium September 15, 2026; staff to set its length; could return in early December.

moratoriums.name: Hillsborough County
moratoriums.notes: Commissioners voted 7-0 on August 5, 2026 to have the county attorney draft a moratorium on AI data centers in unincorporated Hillsborough; it cannot take effect before October 1, 2027 because of SB 180.

moratoriums.name: Martin County
moratoriums.notes: Commissioners voted August 25, 2026, with one opposed, to have staff bring back a one-year moratorium on data centers in unincorporated Martin County; no hearing date set.

moratoriums.name: Linn County
moratoriums.notes: 18 months, unincorporated areas; on top of the February 2026 data center ordinance.

moratoriums.name: Topeka
moratoriums.notes: One year, covering data center and battery storage development. Start date not given in the article read (passed before August 26, 2026).

moratoriums.name: Queen Anne's County
moratoriums.notes: One-year pause; adoption date not given in the source.

moratoriums.name: Jasper County
moratoriums.notes: Covers data centers and cryptocurrency mining in unincorporated areas.

moratoriums.name: Spokane County
moratoriums.notes: Four-month pause on new data center permits; can be extended.

moratoriums.name: Kittitas County
moratoriums.notes: Emergency moratorium; commissioners considering an extension.

moratoriums.name: Skamania County
moratoriums.notes: Adopted between July 28 and Aug 18, 2026; exact date and term not given in the source read.

moratoriums.name: Gallatin
moratoriums.notes: A 60 day pause on new data center applications was approved July 28, 2026 (expired); the Planning Commission recommended a 12-month moratorium on Aug. 25, 2026; the City Council had not voted on it as of the Sept. 8, 2026 report. Councilman Jouvence's original June 2026 proposal was for a two-year moratorium, which the council deferred.

moratoriums.name: Troy
moratoriums.notes: Moratorium started March 16, 2026; the planning commission approved an extension to March 2027 in September 2026, pending a council vote.

moratoriums.name: Marshall
moratoriums.notes: Applies within Marshall city limits; delays data center approvals for 365 days.

moratoriums.name: Shalersville Township
moratoriums.notes: Existing pause extended; adoption date not given in the cited reporting.

moratoriums.name: Freedom Township (Wood County)
moratoriums.notes: Approved by March 13, 2026; current end date not stated.

moratoriums.name: Henry Township (Wood County)
moratoriums.notes: Approved by March 13, 2026; exact dates not stated.

moratoriums.name: Liberty Township (Wood County)
moratoriums.notes: Approved by March 13, 2026; exact dates not stated.

moratoriums.name: Portage Township (Wood County)
moratoriums.notes: Approved during the week of March 13, 2026; current end date not stated.

moratoriums.name: Weston Township (Wood County)
moratoriums.notes: Approved by March 13, 2026; exact dates not stated.
